synth.notes:
Selection is visible in black centres; wall dots override dots inside player holes.
Arrows move the selected axis or piece by one 3x3 block; touching pieces may merge only in extraction.
Reflections mirror the pieces, skip occupied source blocks, and composite through holes over static targets.
Names rank rendered components, including zero-only components for wall/player indices; counter is unchanged.
All 30 transitions also pass in reverse order without history; clicks and full selection-cycle order remain unconfirmed.
